scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Recomputed the W11 amplitude from a time with norm at most the L1 average plus epsilon. The derivative is in the same Banach space E as the amplitude estimate. Fubini bounds the L1 translation by hD. Multiplying the integrand by (2K0)^(p-1) gives h^(1/p), not h, for finite p. Holder on (t,t+h) gives h^(1-1/q)Dq only for q>1 as a small uniform supremum modulus. q=1 removes the positive power; the explicit ramp separately proves failure.

N-translations: Derive a uniform supremum bound from W11 and the L1 time norm.
Use Fubini and bounded-amplitude interpolation for every finite p.
Use Holder for a supremum translation modulus only when q is greater than one.
